media:group.media:title: Morning Worship - Sunday 16th August 2026- #AllAreWelcome
media:group.media:description:
Worship led by Jem Day Organist: Charles Brewster
00:00 - Music before the service

17:10 - 17:51 - Readings: Psalm 133 18:08 - 19:28 - Reading: Matthew 15:21-28 Read by Kate and Sue
20:22 - 23:07 - Hymn: 712 – All people that on Earth do dwell
23:12 - Dedication of gifts, money, talents, time - 'Shared' Prayer -
All: Generous God, Thank You for the talents You plant within each one of us — the creativity that sparks new ideas, the compassion that lifts others up, the strength that carries us through challenges, and the skills that help us shape Your world with love. Leader: We thank You not only for the gifts themselves, but for the joy of using them — for moments when our abilities bless someone else, for opportunities to grow, for the courage to try, and for the grace that turns small offerings into something meaningful in Your kingdom. All: Thank You for making us unique, yet calling us into unity; for weaving our different talents together into a shared purpose that reflects Your heart. Leader: As we offer our gifts today — money, our time, our energy, our creativity, our service — fill us with gratitude, renew our passion, and guide us to use what You’ve given with boldness, kindness, and joy. All: May everything we do shine with Your love and bring hope to those around us. Amen.
